title: CP-2 DeploymentStatus v1alpha1
description: Body of POST /api/v1/devices/{deviceId}/deployments/{dep}/status: one record of the engine's persisted outbox (core/reconciler.py report()). Sent in seq order, re-sent after a cut; the cloud drops seq <= last seen per device (idempotent). Reason texts are registered in reason-codes.v1alpha1.json.
$comment: Closed object: a new field is an additive change to this schema (v1alpha1). The cloud may add fields when it stores a record (fakecloud: receivedAt, deploymentId, deviceId); those are not part of the request. Rules by state: Installing has version, digest, plan; Pending and Failed have a reason; Removing and Removed have a version.

dep.description: Deployment id; equals the {dep} path segment.

state.description: Staged and Stopped (FE-4, x-flex-runState): the release is installed but does not run; Staged = installed and not started since, Stopped = stopped on request and kept for a fast restart. A running deployment is Installed.

deviceTime.description: Unix seconds on the device when the record was made.

manifestVersion.description: manifestVersion of the accepted desired state (null before any was accepted).

version.description: Release version (revision) the record is about.

fromVersion.description: Installing: version being replaced (null for a first install).

plan.description: Installing: the driver's human-readable plan steps.

reasonCode.description: Stable code of `reason` from reason-codes.v1alpha1.json (added 2026-10-17, lead decision; absent when the text is not registered).

operation.description: Pending: the held operation is a removal.

waitingFor.description: Pending, held by x-flex-dependsOn (EV-42): the dependencies not ready yet (FE-GATE-004), or with operation remove the dependents still to be removed first (FE-GATE-005).

stage.description: Failed: the driver's preflight refused the artefact.

keptPrevious.description: Failed (artefact rejected): the previous state keeps running.

interfaceHash.description: Installed: interface hash from the release descriptor.

failure.description: Failed after apply/health gate: the detailed failure (registered text).

failFast.description: The gate ended on a terminal driver failure, not on its timeout.

rolledBackTo.description: Version rolled back to; null = first install, workload removed.

restarts.description: Restart count from local supervision (null for start-limit-hit).

faultVisibleAt.description: mcu-module failure_detail: device-side time the fault became visible (unix s).

faultToHealthySeconds.description: mcu-module failure_detail: fault -> previous version healthy again.

traceparent.description: CP-8: W3C trace context of the span that produced the record (with FLEX_OTEL=1).

correlationId.description: CP-8: trace id = plan correlation id.
